section.content: 一种半导体集成电路具有在约0.5V小电源电压下工作的逻辑电路，其中，即使电路特性随制造工艺条件而改变，逻辑电路的电路噪声容限也能设定在较大值。在工作时间期间能保证满意的速度，并且能降低在空闲时间期间的功率消耗。这通过控制逻辑电路形成在其中的第一、第二导电类型阱的单个电位而实现。为此，设置有控制阱电压的两个电压供给电路和逻辑阈电压发生器。

A semiconductor integrated circuit has a logic circuit operated at a small power supply voltage of about 0.5V, wherein a noise margin of the logic circuit can be set at a larger value even if characteristics of the circuit vary depending upon manufacturing process conditions. Satisfactory speed can be ensured during an operation and power consumption can be reduced during a stand-by time. This is attained by controlling individual potentials of first and second conductivity type wells in which a logic circuit is formed. For this purpose, two voltage supply circuits for controlling voltages of the wells and a logic threshold voltage generator are provided.

Semiconductor integrated circuitThe application based on and to require the applying date be the benefit of priority of the Japanese patent application formerly on March 30th, 2000, its whole contents will be combined in this with for referencial use.

Technical field

The present invention relates to semiconductor integrated circuit, relate in particular to the semiconductor integrated circuit of the complementary mis logical circuit of under a plurality of power supplys, working and be included in operation at low power supply voltage.

Background technology

The number of the semiconductor element that recently, forms on chip greatly increases.Integrated several hundred million semiconductor elements of each chip in the kilomegabit semiconductor memory, integrated several ten thousand to ten million semiconductor elements of each chip in 64-bit microprocessor.Improve the semiconductor element number that on chip, forms by the size that reduces semiconductor element.The MOS transistor that gate length is 0.15 micron is used for 1G bit DRAM (dynamic random access memory) at present.When the number that forms semiconductor element on chip further increases, will adopt 0.1 micron of gate length or littler MOS transistor in the future.

Yet,, the MOS transistor of miniaturization is degenerated because the deielectric-coating that hot carrier and TDDB (time correlation dielectric breakdown) cause punctures.In addition, when the channel length of FET reduced, the threshold voltage of FET also reduced.For preventing that threshold voltage from reducing, increase the substrate zone of FET or the impurity concentration of channel region.Yet when impurity concentration increased, the source of FET/drain junction voltage also reduced.

Aspect the reliability that keeps miniaturization MOS transistor and FET, it is effective reducing supply voltage.More specifically,, weaken electric field transversely between source and leakage, prevent that hot carrier from producing by reducing supply voltage.And, by reducing supply voltage, weaken at the electric field on vertically between grid and the body, prevent TDDB.And, by reducing supply voltage, be applied to Lou and the attenuating of the reverse biased of tying between the body.Like this, the puncture voltage that can overcome knot reduces.

Recently, the market of portable information apparatus significantly increases.Most portable information apparatus adopt lightweight power supply, for example the lithium ion battery of high-energy-density.Yet the 3V lithium ion battery is higher than the puncture voltage of miniaturization MOS transistor.Therefore, when lithium ion battery is used to comprise the transistorized circuit of miniaturization, must use power supply voltage converter to reduce voltage.It is not only proportional with operating frequency to be used for the power that the cmos circuit duration of work of logical circuit consumed, and square proportional with supply voltage.Therefore, the reduction supply voltage will greatly reduce the power consumption in the chip.

Use the mancarried device requirement to use the battery of high-energy-density, have high efficiency power supply voltage converter and integrated circuit is under low pressure worked for a long time.If the supply voltage that lowers can be used for the microprocessor and the base band LSI of consumed power, can further save power consumption.

Portable information apparatus also needs storage arrangement for example DRAM or SRAM except logical circuit.Yet, different with logical circuit, actively do not make great efforts to reduce the power consumption in the storage arrangement.In order to reduce the soft error among the DRAM, must in the unit of DRAM, keep the electric charge of sufficient amount.And, must prevent the tick-over under low supply voltage among the SRAM.

Therefore, have only the element that under the supply voltage of about 1.5V, to work to drop into actual the use at present.Yet,, can provide many power supplys of various supply voltages to be used for comprising the LST of memory circuitry and logical circuit because logical circuit can work under than the littler voltage of the supply voltage of storage arrangement.

Fig. 1 represents the semiconductor integrated circuit 604 that uses in the portable information apparatus, and wherein on-chip memory circuit 603 and logical circuit 602 are integrated on the same chip.Its power-supply system is also shown in Figure 1.

Power-supply system comprises lithium rechargeable battery 600 and power supply voltage converter 601.Power supply voltage converter 601 converts the output voltage 3V of lithium battery 600 to 0.5V.The voltage of conversion is supplied with logical circuit 602.Because on-chip memory circuit 603 needs 1.5V-2.0V or higher supply voltage to be used for work usually, from lithium battery 600 the power supply voltage supplying memory circuitry 603 of 3V.

In the circuit arrangement of Fig. 1, can be reduced to about 0.5V from 3V if supply with the supply voltage of logical circuit, the energy consumption of duration of work can reduce 95% in theory sharp.Yet,, operating rate or the work that reduces cmos circuit is stopped if only being reduced in the 3V-2V supply voltage of the universal CMOS circuit of work down simply.

For overcoming these problems, must be with reducing the threshold voltage that supply voltage lowers MOS transistor.For being configured in the logical circuit of 0.5V operation at low power supply voltage, for example should use MOSFET with about 0.1-0.15V threshold voltage, this threshold voltage be conventional MOS FET threshold voltage about 1/3.

Yet, for this low threshold voltage, be 100mA/decade for example if determine the S factor of the subthreshold characteristic of MOSFET, the leakage current during the deadline of MOSFET is increased to 100 times sharp.Therefore, though by reducing the power consumption that supply voltage has reduced duration of work simply, the power consumption during free time greatly increases.This means that owing to the free time power consumption, the up duration of device shortens.Therefore, the means of aforesaid reduction supply voltage are not suitable for the semiconductor integrated circuit that uses in the portable information apparatus.

Fig. 2 is expressed as and overcomes the problems referred to above and improved circuit.In this circuit, minimum voltage 0.5V offers semiconductor integrated circuit 705 by power supply voltage converter 701 and supply voltage VD1 (0.5V) offers logical circuit 702.This just realizes the low power consumption during the operating time.

And, positive voltage generator 703 and negative supply voltage generator 704 are set produce respectively greater than the voltage of supply voltage VD1 with less than the voltage of earth potential VSS.

The supply voltages that voltage generator 703 and 704 produces offer the n-trap and the p-trap of logical circuit 702 respectively, reducing during normal working hours the absolute value of the threshold voltage of MOSFET in the logical circuit 702, thereby improve operating rate.In addition, at one's leisure between during increase the absolute value of the threshold voltage of the MOSFET in the logical circuit 702, reducing the leakage current during deadline, thereby reduce power consumption.

Yet, when supplying with minimum power supply voltage, 0.5V, often go wrong.For example, positive voltage generator 703 and the negative-voltage generator 704 of supply pump system in being usually used in semiconductor integrated circuit.Yet when supply voltage was low to moderate 0.5V, the supply pump system did not have enough driving forces to come the control trap current potential.In order to improve the driving force of supply pump system when supply voltage is low to moderate 0.5V, must be increased to full-size to the size of driver MOSFET.As a result, voltage generator 703 and 704 layout areas are greater than traditional circuit.

And, because for the on-chip memory circuit, need 1.5V or bigger supply voltage, therefore need another supply voltage.In addition, be low to moderate 0.5V, may reduce the noise margin of gate circuit because be used for the supply voltage of logical circuit 702.In the worst case, according to the threshold voltage of MOSFET in the logical circuit, circuit can not be worked.

Fig. 3 is expressed as the circuit diagram that overcomes the leakage problem during deadline and design.Three kinds of supply voltages are set in semiconductor integrated circuit 805.The 3V supply voltage (VDD) and the earth potential (VSS) of secondary cell 800 offer memory circuitry 804, and memory circuitry 804 is integrated in the semiconductor integrated circuit 805.Simultaneously, the supply voltage VD1 (0.5V) that supplies with from power supply voltage converter 801 is connected to the power line VDDV of logical circuit 802 through the p-channel mosfet 803 with high threshold voltage.

In the circuit of Fig. 3 because the power supply of supplying with logical circuit 802 at one's leisure interval separated, therefore at one's leisure between before must be stored in the flip-flop data in the logical circuit 802 in the memory circuitry 804.Storage in logical circuit 802 in memory circuitry 804 after, supply voltage VDD offers the grid of p-channel mosfet 803 during disconnecting the free time of MOSFET803.Because leakage current is determined that by the cut-off characteristics of the p-channel mosfet 803 with big threshold voltage this moment, leakage current became minimum.

And because the supply voltage of logical circuit 802 is 0.5V, the noise margin of gate circuit may be not enough.As a result, the threshold voltage variations of MOSFET in the dependency logic circuit 803, circuit may not worked.And when minimum voltage 0.5V was provided, because the connection resistance of switching transistor 803, supply voltage significantly reduced.As a result, the circuit tolerance limit further reduces or the power-efficient reduction.

The reason of the circuit tolerance limit reduction of gate when supply voltage drops to 0.5V will more specifically be explained.The figure of the circuit noise tolerance limit that the threshold voltage VthN that Fig. 4 is illustrated under the following condition threshold voltage VthP that uses the p-channel mosfet and n-channel mosfet obtains by breadboardin as parameter: work under the worst case that the circuit with 4-input " with non-(NAND) " door and 4-input " or non-(NOR) " that uses that 0.25 μ m technology forms is described in the back.The n-trap potential is that 0.45V and p-trap potential are 0.0V.Set the input signal except that echo signal, make door be the OFF state.More specifically, supply voltage offers NOT-AND gate as input signal and earth potential offers NOR gate as input signal.The temperature of MOSFET is set in 85 ℃, and 85 ℃ is the upper limit of junction temperature, and supply voltage is 0.45V.Suppose that supply voltage does not descend and earth potential does not raise.

At the input signal that provides noise source signal " vn " as NOT-AND gate and provide noise source signal " vn " to determine noise margin under as the worst case of the input signal of NOR gate.Find to obtain when the VthP=-VthN maximum circuit noise tolerance limit from Fig. 4.More specifically because threshold condition (that is, and VthP=-0.10V, VthN=0.10V) down noise margin is about 0.135V, this is suitable when supply voltage is 0.5V, can guarantee the work of LSI to a certain extent.

Yet, when the threshold voltage VthN of n-channel mosfet moves about 0.3V to minus side, that is, VthP=-0.10V, during VthN=-0.20V, the circuit tolerance limit is 20mV, this is almost identical with thermal noise.And, when threshold voltage VthN moves about 0.2V, that is, VthP=-0.10V, during VthN=-0.10V, the circuit noise tolerance limit is 54mV.In fact, not only temperature conditions and supply voltage change, and supply voltage reduces and earth potential raises.Noise margin reduces about 50mV under the condition of worst case.Therefore, even threshold voltage changes only about 0.2V, as if in LSI, be difficult to the operate as normal of executive circuit.

As mentioned above, even in having the complementary MOS circuit of enough circuit tolerance limits, the circuit tolerance limit becomes almost nil sometimes when the about 0.5V of supply voltage.The appearance of this phenomenon is because the threshold voltage of device changes with manufacturing process.

The transfer lag time is 260ps/ level (stage) when VthP=-0.10V and VthN=0.10V.The transfer lag time becomes and reaches 200ps soon when VthN=-0.20V and VthP=-0.10V.On the contrary, the transfer lag time degenerates to 947ps when VthN=0.30V and VthP=-0.10V.Like this, because noise margin is 72mV, as if can executable operations on the function.Yet,, be difficult to such circuit is dropped into actual the use because door speed drops to 1/5.

Because the logical circuit that can work under 0.5V does not almost have the tolerance of manufacturing process variations, but the low power consumption of its free time is favourable, during the operating time, move by enough circuit tolerance limits.For control circuit tolerance limit and transfer lag time in preset range, must form process technology.More specifically, must control the threshold voltage of MOSFET, its variation is no more than ± 0.05V.Yet this method increases the cost of semiconductor integrated circuit inevitably.

Being used for the semiconductor integrated circuit of mancarried device, when satisfying the rate request of duration of work, the low power consumption during operating time and free time is necessary.For realizing the low power consumption during free time, for example known following two kinds of methods.By a method of low power consumption during producing voltage on the chip to come the control trap current potential be to realize free time, this magnitude of voltage is not less than supply voltage and is not more than the earth potential of logical circuit in the semiconductor integrated circuit.Using the good FET of cut-off characteristics to form mains switch is second method.Aspect the low power consumption of these methods during realizing free time is effective.Yet, if in order to realize the low power consumption during the operating time and use the supply voltage of about 0.5V, can there be following problem:

1) owing to there being voltage generator to need bigger layout areas;

2) if reduce supply voltage by mains switch FET, circuit stability reduces so; And

3) if forming the fabrication process condition of 0.5V logical circuit changes, the circuit noise tolerance limit reduces.

Particularly, the circuit noise tolerance limit of door is minimum in the logical circuit of working under the 0.5V supply voltage.Therefore, when because fabrication process condition changes during the modifier parameter, the feature operation tolerance limit is less.As a result, can not guarantee enough productivity ratio for the semiconductor integrated circuit in the functional experiment.

When guaranteeing productivity ratio,, will change operating rate if device parameter changes to certain level.Promptly enable the assurance function operation, the productivity ratio that satisfies the chip of rate request descends.

As mentioned above, be used for the semiconductor integrated circuit of mancarried device, because the range of tolerable variance of device parameter is narrower, must strict control element characteristic and adding technology step.As a result, cost increases inevitably.And, to compare with mill run, the productivity ratio of this semiconductor integrated circuit is low.Therefore, the cost of semiconductor integrated circuit further increases.

Summary of the invention

Basically overcome one or more defectives in the above-mentioned correlation technique with the corresponding to semiconductor integrated circuit of the present invention.

According to the present invention, a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit is provided, comprising:

Semiconductor substrate, it has first trap of first conduction type, second trap of first conduction type, first trap of second conduction type and second trap of second conduction type;

The first, second, third and the 4th power line, the first, second, third and the 4th power supply of output voltage V 1, V2, V3 and V4 is connected respectively to power line, wherein V1＞V2＞V3＞V4;

Complementary metal insulator semiconductor logical circuit, wherein the power end of complementary metal insulator semiconductor logical circuit is connected to second source line and the 3rd power line, and complementary metal insulator semiconductor logical circuit comprises: be formed on the second conducting channel type conductor insulator semiconductor fet in first trap of first conduction type; With the first conducting channel type conductor insulator semiconductor fet in first trap that is formed on second conduction type;

The logic threshold voltage generator, be used to produce the corresponding voltage of logic threshold voltage with complementary metal insulator semiconductor logical circuit, have first circuit element in second trap that is formed on first conduction type and be formed on second circuit element in second trap of second conduction type;

Be used to supply with first voltage supply circuit of the first voltage V, the first voltage V satisfies V2＞V＞V3;

First differential amplifier circuit, wherein the output voltage of logic threshold voltage generator is input to the positive input terminal of amplifying circuit, and the first voltage V is input to the negative input end of amplifying circuit; And

Be used to supply with second voltage supply circuit of the second voltage Vx,

Wherein the output of differential amplifier circuit is connected to first and second traps of first conduction type; And

The second voltage Vx supplies with first and second traps of second conduction type.

Embodiment

Provide a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit according to embodiments of the invention, it has the logical circuit of working under about 0.5V small power supply voltage, wherein, even circuit characteristic changes with the variation of fabrication process condition, the circuit noise tolerance limit of logical circuit also can be set in higher value.

Provide a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit according to embodiments of the invention, wherein in operating rate that can satisfaction guaranted during the operating time and the power consumption during free time can be reduced in.

Comprise four power supplys that are connected with semiconductor integrated circuit, voltage level is different according to embodiments of the invention.Have second power supply the highest and the 3rd ceiling voltage and supply with logical circuit.The output of the CMOS logic threshold voltage generator of CMOS in logical circuit (MIS) logical circuit is connected to the positive input terminal of differential amplifier.The voltage that provides from voltage supply circuit is input to the negative input end of differential amplifier.The output of differential amplifier is connected to first conductive type of trap in the logical circuit.Another voltage Vx supplies with second conductive type of trap of conduction type and first conductivity type opposite in identical logical circuit.Structure whereby can suitably be set the logic threshold voltage of CMOS (MIS) logical circuit by differential amplifier, and irrelevant with the threshold voltage of MISFET.As a result, the work tolerance limit of circuit can be set in maximum.

And, in according to embodiments of the invention,, can set the trap potential of second conduction type arbitrarily because voltage Vx supplies with second conductive type of trap, and irrelevant with the first conduction type trap potential.As a result, reduce the leakage current during free time, and during the operating time, can carry out high speed operation.

And, in according to embodiments of the invention, can use V2 and V3 supply voltage respectively, simply form CMOS logic threshold voltage generator by a few components by grid and the leakage that interconnects p-raceway groove MISFET and n-raceway groove MISFET.And V1 and V4 are as the supply voltage of differential amplifier and trap and first conductive type of trap and the second conductive type of trap electric insulation of differential amplifier.Thereby the working range of differential amplifier can fully be expanded.

Now, embodiments of the invention are described with reference to the accompanying drawings.

(first embodiment)

Fig. 5 represents the semiconductor integrated circuit 111 according to first embodiment of the invention.Semiconductor integrated circuit 111 is moved by four power supplys 100,101,102 and 103 (comprising earth potential or reference potential), four power supplys 100,101,102 and 103 provide voltage V1, V2, V3 and V4 to semiconductor integrated circuit 111 respectively, here V1＞V2＞V3＞V4.

Semiconductor integrated circuit 111 comprises logical circuit 104, CMOS logic threshold voltage generator 105, first voltage supply circuit 106 and differential amplifier circuit 107.Logical circuit 104 comprises the CMOS logical circuit and respectively by the voltage V2 of power supply 101 and 102 and V3 operation.CMOS logic threshold voltage generator 105 produces the threshold voltage of CMOS logical circuit in the logical circuit 104.As for the supply voltage of CMOS logic threshold voltage generator 105, with logical circuit 104 in identical mode supply with V2 and V3.

The output of CMOS logic threshold voltage generator 105 is supplied with the positive input terminal of differential amplifier circuit 107 and is supplied with the negative input end of differential amplifier circuit 107, V2＞V＞V3 here from the voltage V of voltage supply circuit 106 outputs.First conductive type of trap (trap 1) 108a and the 108b in logical circuit 104 and the CMOS logic threshold voltage generator circuit 105 supplied with in the output of differential amplifier 107 respectively.

In semiconductor integrated circuit 111, amplifier 109 (second voltage supply circuit) is set the current potential of second conductive type of trap (trap 2) 110a and 110b in logical circuit 104 and the CMOS logic threshold voltage generator 105 respectively.Amplifier 109 is carried out the impedance conversion and the output voltage V x of variable voltage power supply 112, and power supply 112 can be exported free voltage.

The supply voltage of differential amplifier circuit 107 and amplifier 109 is not limited to V1, V2, V3 and V4.Can use any power source voltage.

Just can reduce power consumption by the magnitude of voltage that reduces duration of work, suppose: (1) V1 and V3 are the supply voltages of differential amplifier 107, the current potential of amplifier 107 control first trap 108a and 108b; (2) V2 and V4 are the supply voltages of amplifier 109, the current potential of amplifier 109 control second trap 110a and 110b; And (3) V1 and V4 are as the supply voltage that is arranged on the memory circuitry in the semiconductor integrated circuit 111.

According to first embodiment, owing to control through the negative feedback of differential amplifier 107, the circuit threshold voltage in the logical circuit 104 becomes current potential V no better than, and current potential V is the current potential of voltage supply circuit 106.If voltage V is set in the median between voltage V2 and the voltage V3, i.e. (V2+V3)/2, then the noise margin maximum of circuit.In addition, the voltage amplification from variable voltage power supply 112 is become Vx, the voltage that has amplified Vx is provided then, just can set the current potential of second conductive type of trap 110 arbitrarily by amplifier 109.

If the first conductive type of trap 108a and 108b are that n-trap and the second conductive type of trap 110a and 110b are the p-traps, if and the current potential Vx of trap 110a and 110b sets for and is lower than V3 during at one's leisure, the threshold voltage of the n-channel mosfet in the logical circuit 104 just can be to positive side shifting.As a result, leakage current is suppressed.On the contrary, if voltage Vx sets for and is higher than V3 during the operating time, threshold voltage moves to minus side.As a result, can improve the operating rate of circuit.Because first trap 108 and second trap 110 are independently controlled at arbitrary state, the circuit tolerance limit maximum of logical circuit.

Fig. 6 represents according to first embodiment, the specific embodiment of CMOS logic threshold voltage generator 105.CMOS logic threshold voltage generator 105 is phase inverters, and phase inverter comprises that the source through MOSFET200 and 201 is connected respectively to p-channel mosfet 200 and the n-channel mosfet 201 of V2 and V3.Obtain the logic threshold voltage of logical circuit 104 by the input and output that interconnect CMOS logic threshold voltage generator 105.P-channel mosfet 200 is formed among the first trap 108b and n-channel mosfet 201 is formed among the second trap 110b.

With with logical circuit 104 in same mode arrange the trap of the MOSFET in the logic threshold voltage generator 105.More specifically, the first trap 108b is connected to the output of differential amplifier 107 and the output that the second trap 110b is connected to amplifier 109.

Figure 15 is the cross-sectional view of Semiconductor substrate 210, and the CMOS logic threshold voltage generator of Fig. 6 is formed on the substrate 210.In the Semiconductor substrate kind, p-channel mosfet 200 is formed among the n-trap 108b.N-channel mosfet 201 is formed among the p-trap 110b, and p-trap 110b is formed in another n-trap 211.On Semiconductor substrate 210, schematically illustrate the interconnection of Fig. 6.The source 214 of MOSFET200 is connected to the V2 power line, and grid 215 are connected to output OUT with leakage 216.Leakage 217 and the grid 218 of MOSFET201 are connected to output OUT, and source 219 is connected to the V3 power line.

The output " OUT " of the CMOS phase inverter shown in Fig. 6 remains on point of safes, and this point of safes is determined by the circuit threshold voltage.The circuit threshold voltage of CMOS phase inverter is determined by the relation between the threshold voltage of the threshold voltage of p-channel mosfet and n-channel mosfet.The threshold voltage of each MOSFET changes with trap potential.If the trap potential of MOSFET is set the trap potential in the logical circuit 104 in the CMOS logic threshold voltage generator 105, the OUT value becomes the accurate circuit threshold voltage of indication logical circuit 104.

Notice that CMOS logic threshold voltage generator 105 can be arranged in the logical circuit 104.More specifically, the p trap 110a with logical circuit 104 is identical with n trap 108a respectively with n trap 108b for the p trap 110b of CMOS logic threshold voltage generator 105, maybe can be the single trap of electrically insulated from one another.Yet, irrelevant on differential amplifier circuit 107 and logical circuit 104 and CMOS logic threshold voltage generator 105 electricity.Therefore, wherein form differential amplifier circuit 107 circuit element trap must with n-trap 108a, 108b and p-trap 110a, 110b electric insulation.

(second embodiment)

Fig. 7 represents the semiconductor integrated circuit 311 according to second embodiment of the invention.Semiconductor integrated circuit 311 is powered by four power supplys 300,301,302 and 303 (comprising earth potential or reference potential), four power supplys 100,101,102 and 103 provide voltage V1, V2, V3 and V4 to semiconductor integrated circuit 111 respectively, here V1＞V2＞V3＞V4.Provide V2 and V3 to logical circuit 304 respectively from power supply 301 and 302, logical circuit 304 comprises the CMOS logical circuit.In semiconductor integrated circuit 311, be provided with differential amplifier circuit 307.By voltage supply circuit 306 voltage V is imported differential amplifier circuit 307, V2＞V＞V3 here.First conductive type of trap 308a and the 308b in logical circuit 304 and the CMOS logic threshold voltage generator 305 supplied with in the output of differential amplifier 307 respectively.The corresponding voltage of threshold voltage of the CMOS logical circuit of 305 generations of CMOS logic threshold voltage generator and logical circuit 304.Differential amplifier circuit 307 adopts V1 and V4 as supply voltage.And the output Vx of amplifier 309 supplies with second conductive type of trap 310a and the 310b in logical circuit 304 and the CMOS logic threshold voltage generator 305 respectively.

In a second embodiment, except V1 and V4 as the supply voltage of differential amplifier 307, with the mode cloth circuits identical with first embodiment shown in Figure 5.By using V1 and V4, can increase the potential range of supplying with first trap 308 sharp as supply voltage.For example, if the first trap 308a and 308b are the n-traps, the current potential of n-trap 308a and 308b determined by the output voltage of differential amplifier 307, and scope is (φ B is the n-trap of p-channel mosfet and the built in potential the source p district here) from V1 to V2-φ B.Therefore, can on wide region, control this current potential.

Fig. 8 provides the specific embodiment that voltage Vx gives the amplifier 309 of second trap.Input voltage vin put from variable voltage power supply 312 supplies with differential amplifier 400 at positive input terminal.The feedback current potential is the output Vx of the differential amplifier 400 that returns through resistor 401, and it offers differential amplifier 400 at negative input end.Vx forms and supplies with second trap 310 thus.Structure by changing the output voltage of power supply 312, just can produce the current potential that is suitable for operating state and idle condition whereby.Notice that any power source voltage can be used for differential amplifier 400.

Amplifier 309 shown in Figure 9 is basically with shown in Figure 8 identical.Amplifier 309 comprises differential amplifier 500, resistor 501 and 502 and variable voltage power supply 312.V1 and V4 are as the supply voltage of differential amplifier 500.

According to circuit shown in Figure 9, can increase the working range of differential amplifier 500.For example, if the second trap 310a and the 310b that are connected with the output of differential amplifier 500 are the p-traps, the current potential of trap 310 determined by the output voltage of differential amplifier 500, and scope is (φ B is the p-trap of n-channel mosfet and the built in potential the source n-district here) from V4 to V3+ φ B.Therefore, can on wide region, control this current potential.

Then, if in the logical circuit potential setting of second trap at V4 in the scope of V3+ φ B, and the potential setting of first trap at V2-φ B in the scope of V1, first trap and second trap all can be controlled in the wide region.

Now, with reference to the example of Fig. 5 discussion according to semiconductor integrated circuit of the present invention.In the present embodiment, the semiconductor integrated circuit that 0.25 μ mCMOS technology is made will be passed through discussion.The supply voltage of V1, V2, V3 and V4 is set in 3V, 1.75V, 1.25V and 0V respectively.Suppose that first trap is that the n-trap and second trap are the p-traps.The circuit arrangement of Fig. 6 becomes the CMOS logic threshold voltage generator 105 in the logical circuit 104.This moment, the grid width of p-channel mosfet and n-channel mosfet was respectively 2 μ m and 1 μ m, and they are identical with the grid width of phase inverter in the logical circuit 104.V2 and V3 are as the supply voltage of logic threshold voltage generator 105.The voltage that two 2k Ω resistor power distribution voltage V1 that are connected in series in voltage supply circuit 106 and V4 provide.Therefore, supply with 1.5V voltage from voltage supply circuit 106.And circuit shown in Figure 10 is used to provide current potential to the first trap 108a and 108b (n trap) as differential amplifier 107.

In Figure 10, the first order comprises the differential amplifier with n-channel mosfet 1008 and 1010, n-channel mosfet 1008 and 1010 each have the grid width of 4 μ m.Differential output converts single-phase output to by the current mirror circuit of p-channel mosfet 1007 and 1009, p-channel mosfet 1007 and 1009 each have the grid width of 15 μ m.The single-phase output of p-channel mosfet 1012 outputs by having grid width 120 μ m, and with it as second level amplifier circuit.In differential amplifier, in order to carry out compensation mutually, by the resistor that 1.0pF capacitor 1015 and the grid that provide fixed voltage to MOSFET1013 produce, the output of second level amplifier circuit feeds back to the input of the p-channel mosfet 1012 of grid width 120 μ m.
